description: Over nonempty domains, \((\forall u\,R(u,u))\to\exists v\,R(v,x_0)\) is equivalent first to \((\exists u\,\neg R(u,u))\lor(\exists v\,R(v,x_0))\), then to \(\exists u\exists v\,(\neg R(u,u)\lor R(v,x_0))\).
